_comment: Shared by DesignTokenRatchetTests (swift test) and scripts/check-design.py (no build). Counts may only go down: fix a site and lower its baseline in the same change, never raise one. Patterns must work in both NSRegularExpression and Python re. Sites under Theme/ and comment lines are skipped. What remains in 'system status color' and 'hard-coded color literal' is categorical (model family, chat labels, ANSI, syntax, badges), not status.

rules.name: bare static TurboSparkTheme accessor
rules.fix: use TurboSparkTheme.x(isDark: theme.isDark) or the resolved theme

rules.name: hard-coded border opacity
rules.fix: stroke .appBorder as the theme gives it

rules.name: system NSColor on a themed surface
hard-coded color literal
rules.fix: add a role to Theme/ (ResolvedAppTheme) instead of a literal in a view
